A yellow thread stand and several thread cones are mounted beside the machine; a thread trimmer/pliers tool sits on the floor.
Photo 2 shows the brand name 'EMEL' printed on the machine's arm (text partly obscured by the thread stand pole).
No model plate, serial number, or motor rating plate is clearly legible in any photo.
